sources.title: Jan-Code-4B - Jan
sources.snippet: Jan-Code-4B is a lightweight, code-tuned 4B parameter model built for fast local inference. Fine-tuned on Jan-v3-4B-base-instruct, it is designed for practical coding tasks with an emphasis on handling well-scoped subtasks reliably while keeping latency and compute requirements low.
